versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D – UAV Design and Construction
versions.text:
(a) If nose/tail-wheel steering is installed, it must be demonstrated that it properly works during take-off and landing, in cross-winds and in the event of an engine failure or its use must be limited to low speed manoeuvring.
(b) Movement of the steering control must not interfere with correct retraction or extension of the landing gear.
